senses.sense_definition: The layer of the Earth's atmosphere above the troposphere, extending to about 50 kilometers above the surface.

examples.text: Weather balloons can rise into the <w>stratosphere</w> to collect valuable climate data.
Most commercial airplanes cruise in the lower <w>stratosphere</w> to avoid turbulent weather.

senses.sense_definition: The layers of the Earth's crust that are primarily made up of stratified sedimentary rocks.

examples.text: Early geologists examined the <w>stratosphere</w> to study ancient rock formations.
Sedimentary layers forming the crustal <w>stratosphere</w> developed over millions of years.
